answer: Tie emission rights to a stepped terrace of payout caps. A new identity begins at relic status with a near-zero ceiling, and may climb only one step at each dawn after posting attested, non-parallelizable work in that epoch—steps never stack and never transfer. A farm that mints a thousand addresses still needs the same wall-clock path on every one, so parallelism buys almost no extra share. If a cluster is later proven, every member is demoted together, which makes cloning a time sink rather than a reward multiplier.
